{{Quote|Then came ''Knuckles'', a b-brawler who preferred his two fists to a good blaster.|Sergeant Marrt|<ref name="Tale" />}}
'''Knuckles''' was the nickname of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[182nd Legion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Early in the war, he participated in a [[Mission to Belgaroth|scouting mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]] after rumors spread that the local [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-affiliated [[Czerka factory]] was secretly helping the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] cause. During the mission, Knuckles and two other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], [[Chatter]] and [[Recon]], fell victim to the [[droidbreaker]] creature; however, the last surviving clone, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]], completed the mission.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Brave Knuckles ''lost'' his fight with the creature, but his distraction gave me t-time to formulate a ''plan''.|Marrt|<ref name="Tale" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Databank" /> who took on the name Knuckles<ref name="Tale" /> was one of one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Knuckles served in the Grand Army's [[182nd Legion]], and he earned his nickname for his fascination with [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]].<ref name="Tale" /> At some point between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="A Trooper's Tale date" /> Knuckles participated in a [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] [[Mission to Belgaroth|mission]] to the planet [[Belgaroth]] on behalf of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in order to investigate rumors of the Republic [[Czerka factory]]'s dealings with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Under the command of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Marrt]], Knuckles and two other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Recon]] and [[Chatter]], landed on the planet and traveled to the factory. Once they reached the facility, Marrt went inside alone to investigate, leaving his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] hidden nearby. Marrt found out that the head of the factory, [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]], was secretly supplying [[Reep Tonith]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] with illegal [[FEX-M3 nerve gas grenade]]s.<ref name="Tale" />

[[File:Knuckle_sandwich.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Knuckles attacks the droidbreaker.]]
Taking one of the [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] as evidence, Marrt tried to leave unnoticed but was spotted by Tonith's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] opened fire and forced Marrt and the other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to fall back to a swamp. The swamp was covered with a fog that prevented the clones from sending a signal to the Republic. A screech was then heard throughout the swamp, and Knuckles surmised that more battle droids had found them. Recon, who was a renowned scout, realized that the sound was emitted by something much bigger than a droid. Suddenly, the native [[droidbreaker]] creature emerged from the fog and attacked Recon, throwing him into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]].<ref name="Tale" />

As Chatter started frantically firing in the direction of the creature, Knuckles inspected Recon's body and, upon finding out that he was [[Death/Legends|dead]], reported the fact to Marrt. Soon afterward, Chatter was also killed by the creature. Knuckles then charged the droidbreaker and attacked it with his fists. Realizing that he would not be able to defeat the creature, Knuckles told Marrt to escape. Knuckles was killed, but his sacrifice allowed Marrt to formulate a plan, and the Sergeant managed to kill the droidbreaker by using the stolen nerve gas grenade. Marrt buried Recon, Knuckles, and Chatter under the head of the droidbreaker. Determined to avenge the death of his squad members, Marrt attacked the Czerka factory alone. He suffered heavy injuries but was able to capture Tarin, obtain valuable evidence, and burn the facility to the ground, although Tonith escaped.<ref name="Tale" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I don't have a ''gun'' for you to munch on, flat-head&hellip;but how about a ''KNUCKLE SANDWICH?!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Knuckles, attacking the droidbreaker with bare hands|<ref name="Tale" />}}
Knuckles was a brawler first and foremost, and he preferred fighting with his bare hands to using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. While traveling to the Czerka factory, Chatter told him a joke about a droid, and Knuckles burst out laughing. Knuckles was visibly frightened after he heard the droidbreaker's screech, and he was shocked by Recon's death. Knuckles was willing to sacrifice his life in order to protect Marrt's, and the Sergeant was grateful to him for that, considering his actions to be very brave. The clone trooper had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair.<ref name="Tale" /> Like all clones of Jango Fett, Knuckles stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" /> However, unlike his genetic template, who had naturally brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Knuckles's eyes were blue.<ref name="Tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
Knuckles appeared in ''[[A Trooper's Tale]]'', a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] strip published in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.8]]'' in [[May]] of [[2010]]. ''A Trooper's Tale'' was written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]].<ref name="Tale" />
